audience: independent locksmith companies and small mobile security-service teams
topic: dispatch, authorization, and stock workflows for locksmith service calls

products.name: Locksmith Call Intake Packet
products.product: A focused locksmith service call intake workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent locksmith companies and small mobile security-service teams
products.problem: Urgent calls reach technicians without verified location, contact authority, lock context, access constraints, or a clear requested outcome.
products.valueProposition: Turns locksmith service call intake into a visible operating queue so every dispatched locksmith receives a complete, authorized call packet and an explicit service objective.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets locksmith service call intake software, locksmith service call intake tracker, locksmith service call intake template, and locksmith service call intake checklist searches.

products.name: Locksmith Truck Stock Reconciliation
products.product: A focused locksmith key blank and hardware stock workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent locksmith companies and small mobile security-service teams
products.problem: Key blanks, cylinders, pins, batteries, and specialty hardware are consumed on mobile jobs while replenishment depends on end-of-day memory.
products.valueProposition: Turns locksmith key blank and hardware stock into a visible operating queue so every released route has the required usable stock or a documented sourcing and service-plan decision.
